modals.aiPrompt:
Create a word list for learning in CSV format (semicolon-separated ";").
IMPORTANT: word and translation as usual, but the EXPLANATION, EXAMPLE and PART OF SPEECH must be strictly in the language being learned (e.g. Norwegian).

Row format: word; translation; explanation (in the target language); example (in the target language); part of speech (in the target language).

Here's the word list: [PASTE YOUR WORDS HERE]

stats.setDone: You've gone through the whole set!

coach.recall: First try to recall the translation yourself — then show the answer. On your phone, just tap the card.
coach.rate: Rate honestly — each button shows when the word will return. “Don't know” brings it back in this session, “Know” sends it the furthest. On your phone you can swipe: right for “Remember”, left for “Don't know”.
